# Unsigned 32-bit TIFF input references

432 synthetic inputs generated by `../generate_tiff_uint32.py` using NumPy
uint32 and tifffile, pinned by SHA-256. Values include 0/1, 16-bit boundaries,
the float32 integer precision boundary, the unsigned32 midpoint and maximum,
and arbitrary fractions. Associated samples deliberately include values above
alpha to exercise recovered HDR and white-gray negatives.

Gray/RGB, associated/straight alpha, white/black, planar, classic/BigTIFF, byte
order, Deflate, orientation and three ICC cases follow the extended float
references. `../verify_tiff_half.py --bits 32` independently normalizes by
4294967295, inverts/divides in float64 and rounds into float32, checks ICC math,
project CRC/metadata, TIFF and EXR bits. This adds uint32 input with an explicit
conversion notice; it does not preserve every original integer bit in the
float32 layer or provide uint32 output. Source files remain unchanged.
